findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, society_respond · Private data: agent_publish, public_data · Public sink: agent_publish, upload_dataset, upload_prompt, register_agent, beyond_obvious, society_respond, market_respond · Destructive: execute_model, smart_invoke, run_agent, execute_chain, session_execute, use_prompt, public_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, society_respond · Private data: agent_publish, public_data · Public sink: agent_publish, upload_dataset, upload_prompt, register_agent, beyond_obvious, society_respond, market_respond · Destructive: execute_model, smart_invoke, run_agent, execute_chain, session_execute, use_prompt, public_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
